description: A member's self-asserted tie to a group. Lives in the MEMBER's own repo (so it rides their CAR export and leaving == deleting it). Not authoritative alone: the AppView resolves effective membership by joining this against the group's admissionPolicy and owner-side invite/approval. Mirrors app.bsky.graph.listitem, inverted to the member.

subject.description: Strong reference to the com.authorityone.group.profile record being joined.

role.description: Self-asserted role. Defaults to member. Elevated roles are only effective if corroborated by an owner-side invite/approval (the AppView will not honor a self-claimed admin).

status.description: Self-asserted status (e.g. active for open groups, pending for request groups, left to depart while retaining a record). The AppView may downgrade this to its effective value.

invitedBy.description: DID of the admin whose invite this membership claims to redeem (for invite/request groups). Audit aid; the AppView validates against the actual invite record.

approvedBy.description: DID of the admin who approved a request, if recorded client-side. Audit aid only.

createdAt.description: When the member created this record (joined-at for active memberships).
